A Relic Reborn._line:
The 2.x Zodiac questline. Start 'The Weaponsmith of Legend' from Nedrick Ironheart at Vesper Bay (Western Thanalan); it introduces the blacksmith Gerolt in North Shroud.
Eight stages: Relic → Zenith → Atma → Animus → Novus → Nexus → Zodiac → Zeta.
A Relic Reborn.Atma:
IL100 - Jalzahn handles upgrades from here on.
1. Finish the one-time quest 'Up in Arms' to meet Jalzahn.
2. With your Zenith weapon equipped, run FATEs for all 12 Atma (~20% drop). The zone sets the type:
- La Noscea: Lion, Water-bearer, Ram, Crab, Fish
- Thanalan: Bull, Scales, Twins, Scorpion
- Black Shroud: Archer, Goat, Maiden
3. Trade the 12 Atma and the weapon to Jalzahn.
A Relic Reborn.Animus:
IL100, the longest step.
1. Finish 'Trials of the Braves' to meet G'jusana.
2. Complete 9 'Trials of the Braves' books with your Atma weapon equipped (100 Poetics each, 900 total; one at a time - finish each before buying the next).
3. Trade to Jalzahn.
Each book is a checklist of enemies, dungeons, FATEs and leves. The FATEs are the slow part, and some Grand Company leves need Chief Sergeant rank.
A Relic Reborn.Nexus:
IL115 - a Light grind, no materials.
1. Finish 'Mmmmmm, Soulglazed Relics'.
2. Have Jalzahn Soulglaze your Novus weapon (Paladin: both sword and shield).
3. Run duties with it equipped to absorb Light - dungeons, trials, FATEs, Treasure Hunts, PvP. Check progress with the Zodiac Glass.
Fastest unsynced:
- Final Coil of Bahamut Turn 4, Bowl of Embers (Extreme), Thornmarch (Extreme), The Aurum Vale, Thousand Maws of Toto-Rak
Tip: some duties give bonus Light every 2 hours. 100 dungeon runs in a day locks the Duty Finder until reset.
A Relic Reborn.Zeta:
IL135, the final step.
1. Finish 'Rise and Shine' to meet Remon in Swiftperch (Western La Noscea).
2. Buy 12 Mahatma (50 Poetics each, 600 total), one at a time.
3. Awaken each by running duties with the weapon equipped (same fast duties as Nexus); check with the Zodiac Glass.
4. Return to Jalzahn for the Zeta weapon.
Tip: your first Zeta unlocks 'The Vital Title' and 'Kettle to the Mettle', and Drake in Hyrstmill then sells replicas of the earlier steps.
A Relic Reborn.Relic:
Base IL80 weapon - one 'A Relic Reborn' quest per job from Gerolt.
1. Kill the set enemies, clear the level 50 dungeons and trials (unsynced is fine; Amdapor Keep must be unlocked) and gather a few items.
2. Prepare the job's crafted weapon melded with two materia - craft it or buy it on the Market Board (mats include Unspoiled Node items and drops from The Wanderer's Palace and Trauma Queen).
3. Turn in 1 Radz-at-Han Quenching Oil (15 Poetics from Auriana in Mor Dhona).
Tip: buy 3 Thavnairian Mist (20 Poetics each) at the same time for the Zenith step.
A Relic Reborn.Zenith:
IL90 - no quest, just an exchange.
1. Buy 3 Thavnairian Mist (20 Poetics each) from Auriana in Mor Dhona.
2. Trade them with your base Zodiac weapon at the Furnace next to Gerolt in North Shroud.
A Relic Reborn.Novus:
IL110.
1. Finish 'Celestial Radiance' and 'Star Light, Star Bright' to meet Hubairtin in Central Thanalan.
2. Buy 3 Superior Enchanted Ink (25 Poetics each) for a Sphere Scroll.
3. Fill the scroll with 75 Alexandrite and 75 infused materia, then trade to Jalzahn.
Alexandrite:
- Buy Mysterious Maps from Auriana (75 Poetics each), Decipher, then Dig - each chest gives 5, so 15 maps per weapon (~1,125 Poetics).
- One free map a day from Brangwine's 'Morbid Motivation' (Duty Roulette: High-level Dungeons).
Materia:
- Infuse 75 successfully, Grade I → II → III → IV. A fail costs the materia but not the Alexandrite.
Tip: prepare ~20 of each grade, using the cheapest stats on your server.
A Relic Reborn.Zodiac:
IL125 (Zodiac Braves).
1. Finish 'Wherefore Art Thou, Zodiac' and its 4 sub-quests (3 in Mor Dhona, 1 in Central Thanalan; unlock the listed Hard dungeons). Each rewards a special material: Book of Skylight, Zodium, Flawless Alexandrite, Zodiac Scroll.
2. Gather the per-weapon materials below.
3. First weapon: turn in to Gerolt ('His Dark Materia'). Later weapons: Jalzahn ('Zodiac Weapon Recreation').
Per weapon:
- 4 Bombard Core (20,000 Company Seals each)
- 4 Sacred Spring Water (200 Poetics each)
- 1 each of Furite Sand, Allagan Resin, Bronze Lake Crystal and Brass Kettle (100,000 gil each)
- 8 HQ crafts: Perfect Firewood, Perfect Pestle, Perfect Mortar, Furnace Ring, Perfect Vellum, Perfect Cloth, Perfect Pounce, Tailor-made Eel Pie (Master Recipe I; ingredients from desynthing Silver Bazaar items)
Tip: the four sub-quest rewards can be prefarmed before Nexus - the Tracker credits owned rewards toward their materials.

Anima Weapons._line:
The Heavensward Anima questline - unlock with 'An Unexpected Proposal', then repeat 'Soul Without Life' per weapon. Ardashir in Azys Lla handles upgrades.
Eight stages: Animated → Awoken → Anima → Hyperconductive → Reconditioned → Sharpened → Complete → Lux.
Anima Weapons.Animated:
IL170.
1. Farm 1 Luminous Crystal from FATEs in each of the 6 Heavensward zones (~33% drop):
- Astral Nodule: Wind (The Sea of Clouds), Fire (Azys Lla), Lightning (The Churning Mists)
- Umbral Nodule: Ice (Coerthas Western Highlands), Earth (The Dravanian Forelands), Water (The Dravanian Hinterlands)
2. Trade them to Syndony in Mor Dhona for 1 Astral Nodule and 1 Umbral Nodule.
3. Hand both to Ardashir.
Tip: alternatively trade in a Zodiac Zeta weapon (you lose it).
Anima Weapons.Awoken:
IL200 - quest 'Toughening Up', no materials.
1. Clear these 10 dungeons IN ORDER, with the Animated weapon equipped when you click the exit portal:
- Snowcloak, Sastasha (Hard), The Sunken Temple of Qarn (Hard), The Keeper of the Lake, The Wanderer's Palace (Hard), Amdapor Keep (Hard), The Dusk Vigil, Sohm Al, The Aery, The Vault
2. Turn in at Azys Lla.
Tip: soloable unsynced via Unrestricted Party.
Anima Weapons.Anima:
IL210 - quest 'Coming into Its Own'.
1. Collect the 56 items below.
2. Trade them to Cristiana in Mor Dhona for 4 special items.
3. Deliver those to Gerolt.
Per weapon:
- 10 each of Unidentifiable Bone, Shell, Ore and Seeds (40 total; 150 Poetics each from Sundry Splendors, or tribal tokens / Alexander: Gordias loot)
- 4 each of Adamantite Francesca, Titanium Alloy Mirror, Dispelling Arrow and Kingcake (16 total; crafted, Market Board, or 5,000 Company Seals each)
Anima Weapons.Hyperconductive:
IL230 - quest 'Finding Your Voice'.
1. Buy 5 Aether Oil from Sundry Splendors (350 Poetics each, 1,750 total).
2. Turn them in.
Anima Weapons.Reconditioned:
IL240 - quest 'A Dream Fulfilled'.
1. Collect roughly 57-60 each of Umbrite and Crystal Sand.
2. Have Ulan in Idyllshire make Refined Crystal Sand and allocate the stats.
Umbrite:
- 75 Poetics each (~4,500 total)
Crystal Sand (Ulan, 2 per trade):
- 5 Blue Crafters'/Gatherers' Scrip Tokens (125 Purple Scrips), or
- 5 Superior Enchanted Ink + 5 Thavnairian Mist (225 Poetics)
Tip: buying ARR primal parts on the Market Board can be cheaper.
Anima Weapons.Sharpened:
IL260 - quests 'Future Proof' (weapon) plus 'Cut from a Different Cloth' and 'Seeking Inspiration' (materials).
1. Collect 50 Singing Cluster.
2. Trade them to Blamprest in Idyllshire.
3. Deliver to Ardashir.
Singing Cluster:
- 40 Poetics each (2,000 for all 50)
- 1 a day from 'Cut from a Different Cloth' (Duty Roulette: High-level Dungeons)
- 18 a week from 'Seeking Inspiration' (Duty Roulette: Leveling x3)
Anima Weapons.Complete:
IL270 - quests 'Born Again Anima' and 'Some Assembly Required'.
1. Clear 3 Hard dungeons as the matching job (the weapon only needs to be in your inventory): The Lost City of Amdapor, The Great Gubal Library, Sohm Al.
2. Grind aetheric density with the weapon equipped (FATEs, dungeons, trials, raids). Track it with the Enhanced Anima Glass.
3. Buy 15 Pneumite (100 Poetics or 4,000 Company Seals each) for a Newborn Soulstone.
Tip: fastest density is Alexander - The Eyes of the Creator (Savage) / A9S unsynced, ~20 runs (ilvl 610+ to solo).
Anima Weapons.Lux:
IL275, the final step.
1. Finish the one-time quests 'Body and Soul' and 'Words of Wisdom'.
2. 'Best Friends Forever': clear 12 Hard trials in 4 groups - groups in order, any order within a group:
- Bowl of Embers, Howling Eye, The Navel
- Thornmarch, The Whorleater, The Striking Tree, The Akh Afah Amphitheatre
- Thok ast Thok, The Limitless Blue
- Containment Bay S1T7, P1T6, Z1T9 (unlock the Warring Triad via 'Gods of Eld' and 'When the Bough Wakes')
3. Buy 1 Archaic Enchanted Ink (500 Poetics) and turn it in for the final weapon.

Eureka Weapons._line:
Stormblood Eureka weapons, upgraded entirely inside The Forbidden Land, Eureka, and turned in to Gerolt.
Start from the Antiquated weapon (level 70 job quest), then grind elemental crystals across four zones: Anemos → Pagos → Pyros → Hydatos.
15 sub-tiers: Base/+1/+2 → Anemos → Pagos/+1 → Elemental/+1/+2 → Pyros → Hydatos/+1 → Base (Physeos) → Eureka → Physeos.
Tip: crystals from an earlier zone can also be farmed in a later zone once you out-level it.
Eureka Weapons.Base:
Antiquated base (IL290) from your level 70 job quest (replacement 1,000 gil at a Calamity Salvager).
1. In Eureka Anemos, kill Notorious Monsters (Kill-Boss FATEs) and trash for Anemos Crystals.
2. Trade them to Gerolt for 2-5 Protean Crystals each.
3. Spend Protean Crystals: 100 (Base) → 400 (+1) → 800 (+2).
Eureka Weapons.Anemos:
Anemos augment (IL355) - on the matching job, augment the +2 weapon with 3 Pazuzu's Feather.
Pazuzu's Feather:
- 3 per gold-medal clear of the FATE 'Wail in the Willows' (kill Pazuzu)
- or 300 Protean Crystals each from the Expedition Birdwatcher
Eureka Weapons.Pagos:
Eureka Pagos.
1. Get the vitiated aether kettle from Gerolt (level 25 Pagos quest, after owning an Anemos weapon).
2. Fill it by killing NMs and trash, and trade each full charge at the Crystal Forge for 1 Frosted Protean Crystal.
3. Spend 5 Frosted (Pagos) → 10 Frosted + 500 Pagos Crystal (+1). Pagos Crystals drop from NMs.
Tip: the kettle holds 9 charges - turn in before it overflows.
Eureka Weapons.Elemental:
Elemental (IL370): 16 Frosted Protean Crystal + 5 Louhi's Ice.
Louhi's Ice:
- 2 per gold-medal clear of the FATE 'Louhi on Ice' in Eureka Pagos
- or 50 Pagos Crystals each from the Expedition Birdwatcher
Eureka Weapons.Elemental +1:
Eureka Pyros.
1. Farm Pyros Crystals from Notorious Monsters (higher-level NMs drop more).
2. Unlock unique Logos Actions: 10 by Elemental +1, 20 by +2, 30 by Pyros.
3. Spend 150 Pyros Crystal (+1) → 200 (+2).
Eureka Weapons.Pyros:
Pyros (IL385): 300 Pyros Crystal + 5 Penthesilea's Flame, with 30 unique Logos Actions unlocked.
Penthesilea's Flame:
- 3 per gold-medal clear of the FATE 'Lost Epic' (kill Penthesilea)
- or 50 Pyros Crystals each from the Expedition Birdwatcher
Eureka Weapons.Hydatos:
Eureka Hydatos.
1. Farm Hydatos Crystals from NMs - fewer needed, but fewer drop.
2. Spend 50 (Hydatos) → 100 (+1) → 100 (Base Eureka) → 100 (Eureka).
Tip: the FATE 'The Baldesion Arsenal: Expedition Support' is a good source while a BA run is active.
Eureka Weapons.Eureka:
Eureka tier (IL405) - sets the final look and maxes the non-elemental stats.
Costs a last 100 Hydatos Crystal + 5 Crystalline Scale.
Crystalline Scale:
- 3 per gold-medal clear of the FATE 'Crystalline Provenance' in Eureka Hydatos (the only source - the Birdwatcher doesn't sell it)
Tip: for the glamour only, you can stop here; Physeos maxes the elemental stats.
Eureka Weapons.Physeos:
Physeos (final) - same look and stats as Eureka, plus Elemental Bonus stats that make the weapon stronger inside Eureka zones (including The Baldesion Arsenal).
Costs 100 Eureka Fragment, which drop ONLY in The Baldesion Arsenal.
Tip: a full BA clear yields about 28 (each boss drops a share), so roughly 4 successful runs per weapon.

Resistance Weapons._line:
Shadowbringers Resistance weapons (Save the Queen / Bozja). Begin in Gangos with Zlatan after the Shadowbringers MSQ and 'The City of Lost Angels'; the first weapon is free from the 'Fire in the Forge' quest chain.
Six stages: Resistance → Augmented → Recollection → Law's Order → Augmented Law's Order → Blade's.
Most steps trade in Memories of the Dying, farmed in the Bozjan Southern Front and Heavensward/Stormblood content.
Resistance Weapons.Resistance:
Base weapon (IL485).
First weapon:
- free from the one-time chain Hail to the Queen → Path to the Past → The Bozja Incident → Fire in the Forge
Each later weapon:
- repeatable 'Resistance Is (Not) Futile': 4 Thavnairian Scalepowder (250 Poetics each, 1,000 total - Auriana, Hismena, or Sundry Splendors)
Resistance Weapons.Augmented:
IL500 - repeatable 'For Want of a Memory'. Trade 20 each of Tortured, Sorrowful and Harrowing Memories of the Dying.
Where they drop:
- Bozjan Southern Front: random from Skirmishes, Critical Engagements and enemies
- 100% from gold-rated Heavensward FATEs - Tortured: Sea of Clouds / Coerthas Western Highlands; Sorrowful: Dravanian Forelands / Churning Mists; Harrowing: Dravanian Hinterlands / Azys Lla
Tip: keep running Critical Engagements toward Resistance Rank 10 (needed later). The weapon doesn't need to be equipped and the job doesn't need to match.
Resistance Weapons.Recollection:
IL500 - repeatable 'The Will to Resist'. Trade 6 Bitter Memories of the Dying.
Where they drop:
- synced light-party Heavensward dungeons (The Antitower is popular)
- Duty Roulette: Leveling (1 a day)
- Critical Engagements and enemies in the Bozjan Southern Front
Resistance Weapons.Law's Order:
IL510 - repeatable 'Change of Arms'.
1. Raise Resistance Rank to 10 and clear The Battle of Castrum Lacus Litore.
2. Finish the Save the Queen story: A Sign of What's to Come / Fit for a Queen / In the Queen's Image (includes a solo duty and the Delubrum Reginae raid).
3. Trade 15 Loathsome Memories of the Dying.
Loathsome Memories:
- Castrum Lacus Litore (5), any Crystal Tower alliance raid (1), or Critical Engagements (1 random)
Resistance Weapons.Augmented Law's Order:
IL515.
One-time step:
- 'The Resistance Remembers': 18 Haunting Memories of the Dying (Shadow of Mhach raids / Gyr Abania FATEs) + 18 Vexatious Memories of the Dying (Return to Ivalice raids / Othard FATEs)
Per weapon:
- repeatable 'A New Path of Resistance': trade 15 Timeworn Artifacts - 3 per Delubrum Reginae clear (the fast farm, ideally a Party Finder group with Essences), or 1 random from Palace of the Dead (higher floors drop more)
Tip: optionally reallocate stats by turning in 4 Aetherial Sealant (100 Poetics each) at the Allagan Node in Gangos.
Resistance Weapons.Blade's:
IL535, the final weapon.
One-time step:
1. Unlock Zadnor ('A New Playing Field') and complete 'What Dreams Are Made Of'.
2. Spare Parts: 30 Compact Axle + 30 Compact Spring.
3. Tell Me a Story: 30 'A Day in the Life: Battles for the Realm' + 30 'A Day in the Life: Beyond the Rift'.
4. A Fond Memory: 30 Bleak Memory of the Dying + 30 Lurid Memory of the Dying.
These drop from Zadnor skirmishes and critical engagements, or synced Alexander/Omega/Eden raids.
Per weapon:
- repeatable 'Irresistible': trade 15 Raw Emotions - 3 per The Dalriada clear, 2 per Delubrum Reginae, 1 from synced Stormblood dungeons (Hells' Lid is popular), or 1 random from Heaven-on-High

Manderville Weapons._line:
Endwalker Manderville weapons, tied to the Hildibrand questline. Unlock by finishing the Endwalker MSQ and the full Hildibrand arc ('The Rise and Fall of Gentlemen' up to 'The Imperfect Gentleman'), then 'Make It a Manderville' for the first relic.
Every stage buys 3 of a Poetics item (500 each, 1,500 total) from Jubrunnah in Radz-at-Han (12.2, 10.9).
Four stages: Manderville → Amazing → Majestic → Mandervillous.
Manderville Weapons.Manderville:
IL615. First relic from 'Make It a Manderville'; later weapons from the repeatable 'Make Another Manderville'.
1. Buy 3 Manderium Meteorite (500 Poetics each, 1,500 total) from Jubrunnah.
Manderville Weapons.Amazing:
IL630 (Amazing Manderville), gated behind the Hildibrand quest 'Generational Bonding'.
1. Repeatable 'The Next Mander-level': buy 3 Complementary Chondrite (500 Poetics each) from Jubrunnah.
Manderville Weapons.Majestic:
IL645 (Majestic Manderville), gated behind 'Not from Around Here'.
1. Repeatable 'In Need of Adjustment': buy 3 Amplifying Achondrite (500 Poetics each) from Jubrunnah.
2. Allocate two attributes (max 293) plus a third (72).
Tip: re-allocate later at the House Manderville Alchemist for 1 Amplifying Achondrite.
Manderville Weapons.Mandervillous:
IL665 (Mandervillous), the final tier and the strongest level 90 weapon. Gated behind 'Gentlemen at Heart'.
1. Repeatable 'Positively Mandervillous': buy 3 Cosmic Crystallite (500 Poetics each) from Jubrunnah.
2. Allocate two attributes (max 306) plus a third (72).
Tip: re-allocate at the House Manderville Alchemist for 1 Cosmic Crystallite.

Phantom Weapons._line:
Dawntrail Phantom weapons (Occult Crescent). Unlock the Occult Crescent questline up to 'Unfamiliar Territory' after the Dawntrail MSQ; the first relic comes from Lydirceil in Phantom Village.
Penumbrae → Umbrae → Obscurum → Eclipticum each have a one-time unlock grind. Then per weapon: exchange 1,500 Allagan Tomestones of Mathematics for 3 arcanite from Ermina (Phantom Village) and trade them, plus the previous weapon, to Dodokkuli.
Occultum (IL795) is a free conversion from Eclipticum via 'Final Phantasm'. North Horn (patch 7.55) gates the final two stages.
Phantom Weapons.Penumbrae:
IL745.
One-time step:
- 'Arcane Artistry' → 'Forging the Phantasmal': 3 each of six Demiatma (Azurite, Verdigris, Malachite, Realgar, Caput Mortuum, Orpiment)
- they drop from Occult Crescent South Horn FATEs / Critical Encounters (~20% from CEs, ~5% from FATEs) or the matching Dawntrail zone FATEs
Per weapon:
- 1,500 Mathematics tomes → 3 Arcanite (Ermina) → Dodokkuli
Tip: keep ~600 Bicolor Gemstones for the Umbrae step.
Phantom Weapons.Umbrae:
IL760.
One-time step:
1. 'Keeping the Old Ways Alive': Rroneek Glue (300,000 gil), Ut'ohmu Siderite (600 Bicolor Gemstones), Synthetic Dark Matter Alpha/Beta/Gamma (crafted or Market Board).
2. 'Aether, Aether, Everywhere': fill the Aetherwell Array with 10,000 each of green/blue/red/yellow aether from Duty Roulettes - Green: High-level Dungeons, Blue: Alliance Raids, Red: Trials, Yellow: Normal Raids (~13-14 days).
Per weapon:
- 3 Waxing Arcanite (1,500 Math tomes) + the matching Penumbrae weapon → Dodokkuli
Tip: don't abandon the aether quest or you restart.
Phantom Weapons.Obscurum:
IL775.
One-time step:
1. 'Timeworn Techniques': Umbral Clay (500,000 gil), Aspected Aetheroconductor / Aspected Aether Agglomerate / Aspected Aetherocatalyst (crafted or Market Board).
2. 'In Pursuit of Perfection': fill the Phantom Glass with 1,200 Crystal Paste over four turn-ins (100/200/300/600), from level 91-100 duties and roulettes.
Per weapon:
- 3 Waning Arcanite (1,500 Math tomes) + the matching Umbrae weapon → Dodokkuli
Tip: no overcap risk on Crystal Paste, but don't abandon the quest or you restart.
Phantom Weapons.Eclipticum:
IL790 - requires North Horn progress.
One-time step:
1. 'Under No Illusion': Monarch Whetstone (500,000 gil), Ascendant Twine / Ancestral Alloy Ingot / Majestic Polish (crafted or Market Board).
2. 'Phantoms to Fillet': turn in 100 each of Phantom Dispeller α/β/γ.
Phantom Dispellers:
- North Horn FATEs give 3 and critical engagements 10 of one type (not the Forked Tower)
- Duty Roulettes: High-level Dungeons 13 α, Trials 5 β, Normal Raids 5 γ per clear
Per weapon:
- 3 Ecliptic Arcanite (1,500 Math tomes) + the matching Obscurum weapon → Dodokkuli ('A Phantom Unveiled')
Phantom Weapons.Occultum:
IL795, the final tier.
1. One-time 'Final Phantasm' (Knowledge Crystal) converts your Eclipticum weapon into Occultum.
2. Further jobs convert the same way at Dodokkuli, with no extra arcanite.
3. Finish 'All Too Fleeting' to wrap up the relic story.

Lucis Tools._line:
ARR Disciple of the Hand & Land relic tools. Start 'Just Tooling Around' from Guiding Star in Mor Dhona (X:21.9, Y:6.9).
Three stages: Mastercraft (IL55) → Supra (IL75) → Lucis (IL90).
Lucis Tools.Mastercraft:
Base IL55 tools from your level 50 Disciple of the Hand or Land class quest.
Each crafter tool is a level 50 three-star craft - no relic currency needed yet.
Lucis Tools.Supra:
IL75 tools (patch 2.3) from Talan in Mor Dhona (X:22, Y:6). Every class also turns in 2 Fieldcraft Demimateria III and 1 Mastercraft Demimateria.
[[Crafters]]
1. Craft the class item from a gathered material (mostly an Unspoiled Node item).
2. Combine it with the 2 Fieldcraft Demimateria III into the final turn-in.
[[Gatherers]]
Hand in a Talan Seal instead:
- Miner: 30 Antumbral Rock
- Botanist: 30 Redolent Log
[[Fisher]]
Catch 1 Olgoi-Khorkhoi: hook a Storm Rider, then mooch it during Heat Waves.
Lucis Tools.Lucis:
IL90 tools (patch 2.5) from Talan. Every class trades its Supra tool plus 5 Moonstone (about 4,000 GC seals each, 20,000 total).
Tip: once you have one crafter Lucis and one gatherer Lucis, a Calamity Salvager sells the other tools in that category for 1,000 gil each - e.g. Miner Lucis unlocks Botanist and Fisher; one crafter Lucis unlocks all crafter tools.
[[Crafters]]
Craft the class-specific final item (~36,500 GC seals all-in; Weaver ~37,400, Culinarian ~29,150).
[[Gatherers]]
Hand in a Talan Mastery Seal:
- Miner: 15 Magicked Oilcloth + 30 Antumbral Rock
- Botanist: 15 Bamboo Paper + 30 Redolent Log
[[Fisher]]
The Mastery Seal needs 15 Glacier Crystal + 10 Gigant Clam.

Skysteel Tools._line:
Heavensward Disciple of the Hand & Land tools, built at the Skysteel Manufactory in the Firmament. Hand-ins go to Denys (X:8.0, Y:10.0), collectables to Spanner, quest steps to Nimie and Emeny.
Six stages: Skysteel → Skysteel +1 → Dragonsung → Augmented Dragonsung → Skysung → Skybuilders'.
Tip: from Augmented Dragonsung on, the current tool must be equipped while you gather or fish the upgrade items.
Skysteel Tools.Skysteel:
Base IL440 tools.
1. Finish 'Mislaid Plans' for a Skysteel Prototype Coffer - it becomes your current class's tool.
2. Other classes' base tools cost 80,000 gil from Denys.
Skysteel Tools.Skysteel +1:
First upgrade (IL455), handed to Denys.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 20 of the tool's first-tier collectable. Each uses one 'Oddly Specific' material (20 Purple Crafters' Scrips at a Scrip Exchange, or Market Board; ~400 scrips per tool) plus a gathered item.
Tip: Atrociraptor Skin and Vampire Vine Sap aren't gatherable (Hunting ventures or Bicolor traders).
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 340 first-tier items + 120 hidden items from the same nodes.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 40 Thinker's Coral at the Thaliak River, Dravanian Hinterlands.
Skysteel Tools.Dragonsung:
Second upgrade (IL475), handed to Denys, then finish the one-time quest 'In Everyone's Best Interests'.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 30 of the second-tier recipe: 'Oddly Specific' mats (~600 Purple Crafters' Scrips), gathered mats and an intermediate craft.
Tip: Zonure Skin and Ovim Fleece come from Hunting ventures or Bicolor traders; Ala Mhigan Salt Crystal is a timed node in The Lochs.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 510 second-tier items + 180 hidden.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 60 Dragonspine at Dragonspit, Coerthas Western Highlands.
Skysteel Tools.Augmented Dragonsung:
Third upgrade (IL485) - talk to Nimie (tool equipped or in your bag) for 'Ever Skyward'. From here the tool must be equipped while gathering or fishing.
[[Crafters]]
1. Craft 18 third-tier collectables at max collectability (each ~20 Purple/Skybuilders' Scrips).
2. Turn them in to Denys for 90 gobbiegoo.
3. Give the gobbiegoo to Nimie.
Tip: collectability returns 2/3/5 gobbiegoo per craft, so 18 crafts best case, 45 worst.
[[Gatherers]]
1. Gather 500 third-tier + 180 hidden items.
2. Turn the third-tier items in for 50 gobbiegoo.
3. Hand the gobbiegoo and the 180 hidden items to Nimie.
[[Fisher]]
1. Catch 60 Petal Shell at Plum Spring, Yanxia.
2. Turn them in for 6 Fisher's Gobbiegoo and give those to Nimie.
Skysteel Tools.Skysung:
Fourth upgrade (IL500) - talk to Nimie for 'The Tools of Tomorrow', then finish 'Oddness in the End'.
[[Crafters]]
1. Craft 21 fourth-tier collectables at max collectability (~420 Purple or Skybuilders' Scrips best case, 1,060 worst).
2. Turn them in for 105 highly viscous gobbiegoo and give it to Nimie.
[[Gatherers]]
1. Gather 600 fourth-tier + 200 hidden items.
2. Turn the fourth-tier items in for 60 highly viscous gobbiegoo and hand it to Nimie with the 200 hidden items.
[[Fisher]]
1. Catch 70 Allagan Hunter at the Alpha Quadrant, Azys Lla.
2. Turn them in for 7 Highly Viscous Fisher's Gobbiegoo and give those to Nimie.
Skysteel Tools.Skybuilders':
Final upgrade (IL510) - talk to Emeny for 'The Pinnacle of Possibility'. Collectables go to Spanner, then Emeny.
[[Crafters]]
1. Craft 20 fifth-tier collectables at max collectability (Expert Recipes; fixed macros work).
2. Turn them in for 60 oddly delicate parts and give them to Emeny.
Cost: ~400 Purple / 600 Skybuilders' Scrips best case, 1,200 / 1,800 worst. Other mats are gathered in The Diadem.
[[Gatherers]]
1. Gather 36 fifth-tier collectables + 750 Diadem items (Diadem central isle).
2. Turn them in for 250 oddly delicate parts + 25 inconceivably delicate parts and give them to Emeny.
[[Fisher]]
1. Catch 50 each of Flintstrike and Pickled Pom collectables at max collectability.
2. Turn them in for 200 Oddly Delicate Fishing Rod Parts + 200 Fishing Reel Parts and give them to Emeny.

Resplendent Tools._line:
Shadowbringers Disciple of the Hand & Land tools - a single Resplendent upgrade.
Crafters and gatherers earn theirs in completely different ways.
Resplendent Tools.Resplendent:
[[Crafters]]
Craft up a chain, handing each component in to Limbeth:
1. Buy Material A (25 Purple Crafters' Scrips each).
2. Craft it into Component A and turn that in for Material B.
3. Craft 2 Material B into Component B and turn it in for Material C.
4. Craft 2 Material C into Component C and turn it in for Final Material.
5. Trade 60 Final Material for the tool.
Tip: at max collectability every step you need about 30 Material A per class (~750 scrips); at minimum up to 240 (~6,000).
[[Gatherers]]
Earned from gathering-log achievements - no materials:
- Miner: record 220 unique miner-only items (I Found That: Miner VII → Resplendent Minefiend's Pickaxe)
- Botanist: record 340 (Botanist VII → Fieldfiend's Hatchet)
Tip: items from any expansion count, including Legendary Node items (Tomes of Regional Folklore).
[[Fisher]]
Catch and record 1,140 unique fish (I Caught That VII → Resplendent Tacklefiend's Rod).

Splendorous Tools._line:
Endwalker Disciple of the Hand & Land tools, built at the Crystarium. Crafters hand collectables to Quinnana (X:10.4, Y:7.7) and upgrade items to Chora-Zoi (X:10.5, Y:7.7).
Seven stages: Splendorous → Augmented → Crystalline → Chora-Zoi's → Brilliant → Vrandtic → Lodestar.
Tip: gatherers and the Fisher must have the current tool equipped while gathering or fishing (the Fisher uses a Select Bait Ball from Quinnana).
Splendorous Tools.Splendorous:
Base IL570 tools.
1. Finish 'An Original Improvement' for a Splendorous Coffer - it becomes your current class's tool.
2. Other classes' base tools cost 750 scrips from Quinnana in the Crystarium.
Splendorous Tools.Augmented:
First upgrade (IL590) - repeatable quest 'A Dedicated Tool'.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 20 first-tier collectables, each from a 'Select' material (25 Purple Crafters' Scrips) plus gathered mats - ~500 scrips best case, 1,500 worst.
Tip: Almasty Fur and Petalouda Scales aren't gatherable (Hunting ventures or Bicolor traders).
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 60 of your collectable plus 180 hidden Splendorous Water/Earth Shards.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 30 each of Platinum Seahorse and Clavekeeper.
Splendorous Tools.Crystalline:
Second upgrade (IL620) - repeatable quest 'An Adaptive Tool'.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 30 second-tier collectables (25 Purple Crafters' Scrips per 'Select' item; ~750 best case, 2,250 worst).
Tip: Ophiotauros Hide and Lunatender Blossom come from Hunting ventures or Bicolor traders.
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 70 of your collectable plus 210 hidden Adaptive Fire/Lightning Crystals.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 40 each of Mirror Image and Spangled Pirarucu.
Splendorous Tools.Chora-Zoi's:
Third upgrade (IL625) - repeatable quest 'A Tool of Her Own'.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 30 third-tier collectables (30 Purple Crafters' Scrips per 'Select' item; ~900 best case, 2,700 worst).
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 70 of your collectable plus 210 hidden Custom Ice/Wind Crystals.
Tip: Aetherial Reduction also yields the components.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 40 each of Gold Dustfish and Forgiven Melancholy.
Splendorous Tools.Brilliant:
Fourth upgrade (IL630) - repeatable quest 'A Tool without Compare'.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 30 fourth-tier collectables (30 Purple Crafters' Scrips per 'Select' item; ~900 best case, 2,700 worst).
[[Gatherers]]
Gather 70 of your collectable plus 210 hidden Brilliant Lightning/Earth Clusters (or use Aetherial Reduction).
[[Fisher]]
Catch 40 each of Oil Slick and Gonzalo's Grace.
Splendorous Tools.Vrandtic:
Fifth upgrade (IL635) - repeatable quest 'A Tool for the Ages'.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 20 fifth-tier collectables (Expert recipes; 35 Purple Crafters' Scrips per 'Select' item; ~700 best case, 2,100 worst).
[[Gatherers]]
Gather ~74 of your collectable plus 220 hidden Inspirational Wind/Fire Clusters.
Tip: ~74 is the best case via Aetherial Reduction; turning in to Quinnana takes 110.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 43 each of Deadwood Shadow and Ronkan Bullion.
Splendorous Tools.Lodestar:
Final upgrade (IL640) - repeatable quest 'Stand Tool, My Friend'.
[[Crafters]]
Craft 20 sixth-tier collectables (Expert recipes; 35 Purple Crafters' Scrips per 'Select' item; ~700 best case, 2,100 worst).
[[Gatherers]]
Gather ~74 of your collectable plus 220 hidden Nightforged Ice/Water Clusters.
Tip: ~74 is the best case via Aetherial Reduction; turning in to Quinnana takes 110.
[[Fisher]]
Catch 43 each of Little Bounty and Saint Fathric's Face.

Cosmic Tools._line:
Dawntrail Disciple of the Hand & Land tools (patch 7.2), upgraded entirely through Cosmic Exploration - nothing to craft, gather or catch.
1. Get the first prototype from a Cosmic Prototype Coffer (quest 'A Cosmic Homecoming'). Later class prototypes are free from Researchingway in the Cosmic zones (Sinus Ardorum, Phaenna, Oizys, Auxesia).
2. Earn per-class research data (Types I-VII) from stellar missions.
3. Talk to Researchingway to upgrade. Tools climb a 19-step ladder from level 10 (ilvl 10) to level 100 (ilvl 780).
Tip: finishing a tool's final tier stage gives a research bonus for the rest of that tier (+50% for 1-2 tools done, +100% for 3-4, +150% for 5+), so finish one tool at a time and do crafters before gatherers.
The Overview and Relic tabs still track your Cosmic progress from FFXIV Collect.
Cosmic Tools.Cosmic:
Novice tier - the base prototype through v0.2-v0.8 to the Cosmic tool, using Type I-IV research data (per class, cumulative).
Needed to reach Cosmic:
- about 2,800 Type I, 2,900 Type II, 2,300 Type III, 1,500 Type IV
Tip: the tool doesn't need to be equipped to earn data, but equipping it for a whole mission adds a zone-credit bonus.
[[Crafters]]
Recommended on Oizys: class D, then class C missions.
[[Gatherers]]
Recommended on Oizys: the class A 'Mineral Gravitational Stabilizers' (Miner) / 'Fibrous Gravitational Stabilizers' (Botanist).
[[Fisher]]
Recommended: 'Northwestern Water Inspection' and 'Absolute Specimen', then 'Aquatic Inspection I'.
Cosmic Tools.Stellar:
Intermediate tier - v1.1-v1.4 up to the Stellar tool, now also needing Type V data.
Cumulative totals at Stellar:
- about 4,700 each of Types I-III, 4,000 Type IV, 1,500 Type V
[[Crafters]]
Recommended: class C, then class B missions.
[[Gatherers]]
Stay on class A, dipping into class B if Type V lags.
Cosmic Tools.Hyper:
Advanced tier - v1.1-v1.2 up to the Hyper tool, adding Type VI data.
Cumulative totals at Hyper:
- about 7,100 each of Types I-IV, 3,150 Type V, 1,900 Type VI
[[Crafters]]
Recommended: class B, then class A.
Tip: Type VI is only on class A and is the longest grind.
[[Gatherers]]
Focus class A 'Gravitational Stabilizers', using class B if Type V lags.
Cosmic Tools.Stellar (final):
Expert tier - the final level 100 / ilvl 780 tool (the Stars stage). v1.1-v1.2 up to Stars, adding Type VII data.
Cumulative totals at Stars:
- about 9,500 each of Types I-IV, 5,600 Type V, 2,700 Type VI, 1,600 Type VII
This is the current end of the line; further upgrades come in later patches.

Eurekan Armor._line:
From Gerolt in The Forbidden Land, Eureka.
Elemental set:
- base: 40 Pyros Crystal
- +1: adds Hydatos Crystal (50 body/legs, 30 smaller pieces)
- +2: adds Eureka Fragment (35 body/legs, 21 smaller pieces)
Eurekan set (Anemos line), per piece:
- 50 Protean Crystal (base), 150 (+1), 400 (+2)
- then 150 Anemos Crystal for the final Anemos stage

Resistance Armor._line:
From the Resistance Supplier.
- Bozjan (Southern Front): Bozjan Coin (98 per set)
- Augmented Bozjan: base piece + Bozjan Runner's Secrets (999 or 500 coin each, or rare Castrum drops; ~3,498 per set)
- Law's Order (Gangos): Bozjan Gold Coin (12 per set)
- Augmented Law's Order: Law's Order + Augmented Bozjan + Orderly Runner's Secrets, each made from 10 slot-specific Runner's Plating (Head/Body/Hand/Leg/Foot - 5 different items, 50 per set; Delubrum Reginae Savage)
- Blade's (Zadnor): Bozjan Platinum Coin (36 per set)

Phantom Armor._line:
South Horn - Arcanaut's (IL745):
- base: 4,000 Enlightenment Silver Piece per piece (20,000 per set)
- +1: adds 3 Aetherspun Silver (≈1,200 Silver each) + 3 Aetherial Fixative (≈1,600 Gold each) per piece
- +2: adds 3 Aetherspun Gold (treasure chests) + 6 X-Fixative (= 60 Sanguinite) per piece
North Horn - Phantom Vision (IL780):
- base: 4,000 Enlightenment Silver Obol per piece (a separate North Horn currency, not Silver Pieces)
- +1/+2/+3: Final Final Fixative (3 / 4 / 8 per piece)
Tip: Arcanaut's +1/+2 can be exchanged 1:1 for matching Phantom Vision +1/+2 at the North Horn armorer.
